title: file open (select + drag-drop) with error handling

unit.note: openFile 11 tests (detectFileType/hasZipMagic/openFile incl. corrupt + nonzip + magic promotion), App shell 1, mdpkg 4, validation 5

scenarios: valid .mdpkg → sandbox iframe preview, no pageerror
corrupted .mdpkg → error alert, no white screen, no pageerror
non-ZIP bytes renamed .mdpkg → error alert, no white screen
opening a second file replaces the current document
